services.name: Sunset Cruise, climate controlled main deck, open-air sky deck
services.desc: Sunset Cruises Looking for a great relaxing way to finish off the day? Come join us aboard for our Sunset Cruise. Watch the sunset over the Dallas skyline from the climate controlled main deck, or open-air upper deck. Enjoy your time aboard our captained and crewed, double-deck motor vessel, accommodating up to 140 passengers plus our crew, with an enclosed climate controlled main deck and a wide open upper deck – designed specifically for your Lake Ray Hubbard Cruise. We have easy access boarding at the Rockwall Harbor near the Scott Self memorial lighthouse – manual wheelchair accessible. 1.5 Hrs. BYOB (beer, wine, seltzer, etc) and your food welcome aboard.
